_comment: Query plan for the 02_tango run. Same shape as queries.json and read by the same scripts/harvest.py --config. The research space is different: agentic systems that drive a simulator, solver, optimiser or scientific code, in any domain, because what transfers to TANGO is the control pattern rather than the physics. Edit this file to widen or narrow coverage; never edit query strings inside the prompt.

A_agentic.note: Explicit agent vocabulary. Identical to queries.json's A_agentic plus 'model context protocol' and 'agentic simulation': MCP is how most 2025-26 systems expose a solver to an LLM, triage matches it, and queries.json never searched for it.

B_llm.note: Foundation-model vocabulary without an agent term. Large and noisy; exists so that systems that drive a solver with an LLM but never use the word 'agent' are still found. Screened hard.

core.note: Anything an agent could drive that TANGO also is or has: a simulation orchestrator, a solver, an optimiser, an energy-system or techno-economic model, a scientific codebase. Domain-agnostic on purpose — process engineering and computational chemistry run the same control loop over a different physics engine.

periphery.note: Harvested for counts and characterisation only. Never deep-read. These are the neighbouring agent literatures whose artefact is not a simulation: a codebase, a robot, a browser, a document. They bound the scope by measurement rather than assertion, and software_engineering is deliberately here — the refactor is not what this run is about.

triage._comment: Read by scripts/triage_tango.py, not by harvest.py. One regex per domain group above, and the keys must match the group names exactly — a group that is harvested but has no triage pattern scores scope 'none' and is dropped from the shortlist without appearing in any count.

core.simulation_orchestration: process simulat|flowsheet|co[- ]simulat|multiphysic|simulation workflow|digital twin|input deck|simulation setup|model configuration|orchestrat\w+ (?:simulation|solver|model)

core.optimisation_uq: surrogate model|bayesian optimi|design of experiment|uncertainty quantificat|sensitivity analysis|multi[- ]objective optimi|parameter sweep|model calibrat|inverse problem|history match|genetic algorithm
core.energy_systems: energy system model|power plant|thermodynamic cycle|organic rankine|district heating|techno[- ]economic|process engineering|heat exchanger|levelized cost|\bLCOE\b|\bORC\b
core.geoenergy_subsurface: geothermal|reservoir simulat|reservoir engineering|enhanced geothermal|carbon storage|\bCCS\b|well placement|subsurface|wellbore|aquifer
core.scientific_computing: scientific computing|research software|scientific software|high performance computing|\bHPC\b|workflow engine|computational science|reproducib|scientific workflow|simulation code|open[- ]source (?:code|package|library)
core.computational_discovery: molecular dynamic|density functional|quantum chemistry|computational materials|atomistic simulat|materials discovery|catalyst design|\bDFT\b

periphery.software_engineering: software engineering|program repair|unit test|pull request|code review|issue resolution|\bSWE[- ]bench\b|repository[- ]level
periphery.lab_automation: laboratory automation|robotic laborator|chemical synthesis|experimental platform|high[- ]throughput screening|wet[- ]lab
periphery.interface_agents: web agent|computer use|graphical user interface|\bGUI\b|robotic process automation|browser automation

triage.general: simulat|solver|numerical model|computational model|engineering model|scientific software|optimi[sz]ation|physics[- ]based|modelling framework|modeling framework

touchpoints._comment: TANGO's own surfaces, from tango_complete_reference.md §2-§3: a YAML graph of units over third-party physics engines, a BC/flow-rate solver, pymoo optimisation, LHS+DVC+SLURM sweeps, GPR surrogates, LCOE/CAPEX economics, an LCOE regression suite, and a Flask/React tier. A hit here is a sorting aid for the screener and a counted signal in triage_stats.md — never an admission and never a claim that the system was built for TANGO.
touchpoints.config_generation: input deck|input file generat|configuration file|\bYAML\b|generat\w+ (?:the )?(?:input|config)|schema validation
touchpoints.surrogate_modelling: surrogate|emulator|reduced[- ]order model|gaussian process regress|machine learning model of
touchpoints.uncertainty_quantification: uncertainty quantificat|sensitivity analysis|monte carlo|latin hypercube|probabilistic forecast
touchpoints.verification_regression: regression test|characteri[sz]ation test|verification and validation|benchmark suite|reference solution|tolerance

venue_hints._comment: Not queried by harvest.py. Passed to the model for the grey-literature pass, which is the one thing the bibliographic APIs cannot reach. Simulation-vendor and HPC-centre material is the 02 equivalent of 01's SPE circuit.
grey: GitHub and Hugging Face (agent harnesses, MCP servers wrapping solvers)
Ansys / COMSOL / AspenTech / Siemens / Schlumberger technical blogs and whitepapers
NVIDIA, Microsoft Research, DeepMind engineering posts
NeurIPS / ICML / ICLR workshop pages not indexed by OpenAlex
